question: What does "Summoning Sickness Rule" mean in Magic: The Gathering?

answers.base:
The "Summoning Sickness Rule" in Magic: The Gathering means that a creature you control cannot attack or block until it has been under your control continuously since your turn began. This rule is formally stated in rule 702.79 of the Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules.

Here is the relevant rule text:

> 702.79. Summoning Sickness
> 
> > 702.79a A creature is afflicted with summoning sickness if it’s a creature card that’s on the battlefield and it’s been under its current controller’s control since the start of that controller’s turn.
> 
> > 702.79b A creature with summoning sickness can’t attack, block, or be the target of an ability unless its controller pays its summoning sickness cost. The summoning sickness cost is usually {1}.
> 
> > 702.79c If a creature with summoning sickness would attack or block, its controller must pay its summoning sickness cost, unless that creature is also a legendary permanent. In that case, its controller may pay its summoning sickness cost or choose to have the creature attack or block without paying that cost. If the creature is legendary and its controller chooses to have it attack or block without paying its summoning sickness cost, the creature is still considered to have summoning sickness. The creature can’t block unless its controller pays its summoning sickness cost, even if the creature is legendary.
> 
> > 702.79d If a creature with summoning sickness would be the target of an ability, its controller may pay its summoning sickness cost, unless that creature is also a legendary permanent. In that case, the controller may pay its summoning sickness cost or choose to have the creature not be the target of the ability. If the creature is legendary and its controller chooses to have the creature not be the target of the ability, the creature is still considered to have summoning sickness. The creature can’t be the target of an ability unless its controller pays its summoning sickness cost, even if the creature is legendary.

This rule applies to all creatures on the battlefield unless they are legendary, in which case the controller has the option to not pay the cost and still have the creature attack, block, or be a target.
